$comment: Hand-maintained semantic-motion review record. Read by scripts/motion-inventory.mjs, which derives everything else (catalog, recipe, mapping source) from the code. Grades: A strongly semantic · B semantic family · C acceptable generic · D weak / generic fallback · E wrong semantics. An icon's grade is the weaker of its outline and filled grades. Only record what was actually inspected; see docs/ai/MOTION-INVENTORY.md for the method.

before.note: Whole glyph hops 6px up and back; nothing opens.

filled.evidence: filmstrip 16/24/48px, 2026-11-04 (front panel is its own subpath)
